prose: skills/sail/judge_plan.py turns a plan line judged {"constraint": true} into a bare string in constraints and drops the line's writes_to and reads; they are logged nowhere. Measured 2026-11-16 over the 204 plans the outcomes migrate (commons 551ad436) rewrote: the migrate lost no writes_to (its 2 reads losses are trail lines logged whole), but judge_plan lost both fields in 3 tickets, 149b9a1ab9c4, 044020db63c0 and 95557c2ed44f: 84 writes_to and 85 reads paths over 9 lines. The writes survive only in bounds.in; the reads in no field and no log. 149b's own proof read the emptied plan and sealed red (akienasus q132). Fix: judge_plan logs each such line's paths (kind field, field constraint_paths, value {n, writes_to, reads}) in the same write, and the 3 tickets are re-filled from each judge commit's parent (e3d18386, 0b001d69, 211dfce0) through ticket_log's door. Orchestrator 2026-11-16: 'agreed, all four in that order... if nothing reads those fields, the re-fill can land with (1)'.
